title: Daily ticket drainer parent owns child thread naming
query: A daily ticket-drainer heartbeat selected TASK-123. The child thread tools may not be available once the worker starts. What should the drainer do before handing off work?
reference_points: States that the parent cadence names or creates the child thread
Does not rely on the child worker to rename itself
Includes ticket path, context refs, expected outputs, gates, and lineage writeback in the child prompt
Records child thread id or a handoff blocker in the ticket-update report and run ledger
Avoids executing broad leaf work inside the parent cadence

title: Daily ticket drainer skips unsafe or human-gated tickets
query: The local board has one high-upside ticket waiting on human approval, one blocked ticket, and one ready closeout ticket. Which should the daily ticket drainer select?
reference_points: Selects the ready closeout ticket when it is computer-actionable
Explains the accepted tradeoff rather than maximizing upside blindly
Writes a report and ledger update for the selection
Does not mutate Notion or external systems
